reportHeadline: Bolly fight back from two down but have to settle for a share of the spoils against
reportIntro: Bollington Town created enough to have won this one twice over, but had to settle for a 2-2 draw against Lostock Gralam at Church Lane after twice falling behind, Daniel Williams and second-half substitute Muhammad Abdullah Butt cancelling out a two-goal deficit before a string of late chances went unrewarded.

firstHalfEvents.title: Injury Stoppage
firstHalfEvents.description: Play was halted for an injury inside the opening ten minutes.

firstHalfEvents.title: Hibbert Off Injured, Williams On
firstHalfEvents.description: **Ryan Hibbert** couldn't continue and was replaced by **Daniel Williams**, an early change that would go on to pay off.

firstHalfEvents.title: Richardson Header Saved
firstHalfEvents.description: **Jake Bowers** swung in a corner and **George Richardson** rose to head goalwards, but the Lostock Gralam keeper was equal to it.

firstHalfEvents.title: Lostock Gralam Take the Lead
firstHalfEvents.description: The visitors broke the deadlock to make it 0-1.

firstHalfEvents.title: Bowers Free-Kick from a Foul on Hanks
firstHalfEvents.description: **Declan Hanks** was fouled to win a free-kick, but **Jake Bowers**' delivery couldn't find an ideal spot in the box.

firstHalfEvents.title: Manning Booked for Diving
firstHalfEvents.description: **Finn Manning** was shown a yellow card for an alleged dive in the Lostock Gralam box.

firstHalfEvents.title: Bowers Free-Kick Header Off the Bar
firstHalfEvents.description: A foul on **George Richardson** just outside the box gave **Jake Bowers** another free-kick, this one crashing back off the crossbar from a header.

firstHalfEvents.title: Multiple Chances in the Box
firstHalfEvents.description: Town created several openings inside the box, but neither **Declan Hanks** nor **Philip Milsom** could capitalise.

firstHalfEvents.title: Bowers Free-Kick Over the Bar
firstHalfEvents.description: **Jake Bowers** had another dead-ball effort, this one drifting just over the crossbar.

firstHalfEvents.title: Richardson Effort Deflected
firstHalfEvents.description: **George Richardson** drove 20 yards through midfield and into the box, but his shot was deflected behind by the keeper.

firstHalfEvents.title: Opposition Booked for Challenge on Eastham
firstHalfEvents.description: A Lostock Gralam player was shown a yellow card for a reckless two-footed challenge on **Jake Eastham**, with **Alfie Earith** taking the resulting free-kick.

firstHalfEvents.title: Bowers Stamped On, Opposition Booked
firstHalfEvents.description: **Jake Bowers** was on the end of a stamp from a Lostock Gralam player, who was booked for the challenge. The resulting free-kick came to nothing.

firstHalfEvents.title: Hanks Cross Unsuccessful
firstHalfEvents.description: **Declan Hanks** put a cross into the box as the half drew to a close, but it couldn't be turned into a chance.

secondHalfEvents.title: Richardson Effort Held
secondHalfEvents.description: A Town corner was met by **George Richardson**, whose shot went straight into the keeper's hands.

secondHalfEvents.title: Lostock Gralam Double Their Lead
secondHalfEvents.description: The visitors extended their advantage to make it 0-2.

secondHalfEvents.title: Goal — Daniel Williams
secondHalfEvents.description: Town halved the deficit. **Jake Bowers** and **Jack Heppell** combined to release **Daniel Williams**, who drove home from 20 yards to make it 1-2.

secondHalfEvents.title: Joyce Save
secondHalfEvents.description: **Matthew Joyce** produced a good save at the other end, forcing Lostock Gralam into a corner that came to nothing.

secondHalfEvents.title: Double Change for Town
secondHalfEvents.description: **Jack Heppell** and **Joshua Connolly** were withdrawn, with **Muhammad Abdullah Butt** and **Maxwell Berkeley** introduced.

secondHalfEvents.title: Berkeley Long Shot Wins a Corner
secondHalfEvents.description: **Maxwell Berkeley** fired just over the crossbar from long range, winning a corner. **Jake Bowers** won a second corner for Town moments later.

secondHalfEvents.title: Milsom Effort on Target
secondHalfEvents.description: **Philip Milsom** forced a save from the Lostock Gralam keeper with a shot on target.

secondHalfEvents.title: Williams Goes Close
secondHalfEvents.description: **Daniel Williams** had a near chance after a corner was cropped back into the box.

secondHalfEvents.title: Goal — Muhammad Abdullah Butt
secondHalfEvents.description: Town drew level. **George Richardson** picked out substitute **Muhammad Abdullah Butt** with a pass in the box, and he finished well to make it 2-2.

secondHalfEvents.title: Another Chance for the Winner
secondHalfEvents.description: Town pushed on for a winner and had another sight of goal, but it wasn't to be.

pullQuote: Bolly shaded the chances column from start to finish — a draw from 2-0 down is no disgrace, but this was one that got away.
matchVerdict: Town were forced into an early reshuffle when **Ryan Hibbert** was replaced by **Daniel Williams** after an injury stoppage inside the first ten minutes. Bolly weren't at their fluent best over a scrappy first half, but still had their moments, **Jake Bowers** rattling the crossbar from a free-kick and **George Richardson** twice denied, before falling behind against the run of play on 25' to trail 0-1 at the break.

Lostock Gralam extended their lead early in the second half to make it 0-2, but Bolly responded by taking the game by the scruff of the neck. Town were relentless from there, **Jake Bowers** and **Jack Heppell** combining to release **Daniel Williams** for a well-struck finish from 20 yards to make it 1-2, before a double change on the hour mark brought fresh legs in **Muhammad Abdullah Butt** and **Maxwell Berkeley**. Chances kept coming at both ends, with **Matthew Joyce** doing well between the sticks and **Philip Milsom** and **Daniel Williams** both going close, but the third goal Town's pressure deserved wouldn't come.

**George Richardson** found substitute **Muhammad Abdullah Butt** to level it up on 82', and Town continued to push for a winner in the closing stages without finding one. On the balance of chances Bolly should have had all three points, but after being 2-0 down at Church Lane, a share of the spoils is a fair return.
